# Which FBA stock should you remove or mark down before the fees eat it?

> Free tool for Amazon FBA sellers: load your Inventory Age report and see, per SKU, the storage fees and aged-inventory surcharge you will pay and whether holding, marking down or removing the stock earns more. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
